name: Moneta
oneLiner: USDM is Moneta's dollar stablecoin on Cardano, issued through U.S. and EEA routes with NBX EMI-license and MiCA-pending framing.
collateral: USD bank deposits and money market funds managed by Fidelity and Western Asset Management (Moneta/USA issuance) and Sparebanken Norge / Amundi USD MM fund (NBX/EEA issuance), held in segregated reserve accounts
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through Moneta (USA) or NBX (EEA); KYC required; Charli3 oracle verifies reserve backing on-chain before each mint on Cardano

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Moneta and NBX disclosures support the fiat-cash classification, but do not provide a complete current deployment-wide account of claim, custody, reconciliation, recovery, and administrative control semantics; those gaps remain unresolved.

genius.notes: USDM has dual U.S./EEA issuer structure: Moneta Digital LLC (FinCEN MSB) for USA issuance, NBX (Finanstilsynet EMI) for EEA issuance. Norway enacted MiCA via kryptoeiendelsloven effective 1 Jul 2025; NBX whitepaper filed Sep 2024. ESMA EMTWP.csv re-checked Jun 2026: no NBX/USDM row present. GENIUS pathway remains unresolved; no PPSI approval exists for any issuer under the still-pending Act.

mintAuthority.summary: USDM is centrally issued on Cardano by Moneta and NBX against stated segregated reserves, with a Charli3 reserve feed consulted before minting, but the Cardano policy script and its controlling key or admin inventory are not publicly retrievable.

controls.label: Moneta / NBX issuance backend
controls.evidence: Moneta (USA) and NBX (EEA) operate the centralized 1:1 mint/redeem for USDM against segregated reserves; a Charli3 oracle attests reserve backing on-chain before each mint, but issuance remains issuer-controlled with no permissionless route.

controls.label: USDM Cardano minting policy (unreadable)
controls.capDescription: The policy hash identifies the Cardano asset's minting rule, but its script, controlling keys, threshold, and recovery or pause inventory are not publicly retrievable with the available keyless endpoints.
controls.evidence: Koios script_info, native_script_list, asset_info, and asset_summary returned no policy or asset record for this hash during the 2026-07-20 review. Without a provisioned Cardano indexer or issuer policy disclosure, no signer, threshold, upgrade, or bypass control is attributed.

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-20. Moneta's materials describe centrally operated, KYC-gated 1:1 USDM issuance by Moneta/NBX against stated segregated reserves; the live Charli3 feed is described as a reserve check before mint, supporting continuous reserve gating. CoinGecko identifies the Cardano policy c48cbb3d5e57ed56e276bc45f99ab39abe94e6cd7ac39fb402da47ad0014df10. Koios script_info, native_script_list, asset_info, and asset_summary yielded no policy or asset record, while no Blockfrost or Maestro credential is present and public explorers were blocked or unreachable. NBX has named Finanstilsynet registry material, but the reviewed evidence does not establish a complete prudential supervisor for the combined Moneta/NBX USDM issuance path, so supervision is not promoted.
unresolvedQuestions: USDM minting policy c48cbb3d5e57ed56e276bc45f99ab39abe94e6cd7ac39fb402da47ad0014df10: the policy script and its controlling key hashes remain unreadable with keyless tooling (2026-07-20: Koios script_info, native_script_list, asset_info, and asset_summary all return no record for the policy/asset; no Blockfrost/Maestro key provisioned; cardanoscan and cexplorer blocked). Resolve via Cardano CLI policy-id inspection, a provisioned Blockfrost/Maestro key, or issuer disclosure of the policy script before raising confidence.

The reviewed materials do not provide a complete current deployment-wide inventory of upgrade, pause, admin, and recovery controls across the Cardano and issuer-operated minting paths; Moneta/NBX have not published the minting-policy script or an admin-control inventory.
